title: rhodanthemum gayanum subsp. demnatense
intro: Rhodanthemum gayanum subsp. demnatense, commonly known as Moroccan chalk daisy, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of Rhodanthemum gayanum subsp. demnatense are believed to be due to its bioactive constituents, although specific studies are limited. Further research is necessary to fully understand its bioactive constituents, which may include flavonoids and terpenoids, but the exact composition is currently unknown.
